This phase inherited the unused envelope (28 invocations / 58 minutes) and continued the causality-guided campaign without reopening or rewriting the predecessor. New evidence: (1) individually traced every importlib.reload( call site across the entire tests/ tree (21 sites, ~20 files) -- none targets pcae.core.hpac_foundation or pcae.core.human_principal_registry, and the one reload of a related module (hpac_verifier) is confirmed by source read to execute exclusively inside a subprocess.run child process, never in-process -- independently closing the reload-call mechanism (distinct from the predecessor's sys.modules key-deletion search) codebase-wide for the classes at issue; (2) confirmed the only monkeypatch.setattr(HPACStoreAuthority, ...) usages (2 files) patch a method attribute auto-restored by pytest's monkeypatch fixture at teardown, not a class-object rebind, and both production consumers import HPACStoreAuthority from the same canonical module via ordinary top-level imports; (3) ran a new bounded adjacent-file composition (the file immediately preceding the victim in normal collection order + victim): 1 failed, 141 passed -- the 1 failure is the pre-existing HISTORICAL-MOVING-AUTHORITY fixed-baseline-diff defect, not the RHAMP signature -- FALSIFIED as sole trigger; (4) built and ran a new disposable pytest plugin performing an EXECUTION-TIME (not merely collection-time, which the predecessor already checked) class-identity trace of HPACStoreAuthority/HumanPrincipalRegistryStore across the full suite in normal order, watchdog-capped at 1200s: reached ~14% of the suite (~80/571 files) with zero identity changes observed, empirically reconfirming (not merely re-estimating) that a full single-process pass (~140 minutes extrapolated) exceeds any single phase's diagnostic budget; (5) reran the clean-context PAWA/PPA/RHAMP/configured-agent band: 7 failed (all the same pre-existing HISTORICAL-MOVING-AUTHORITY guard class), 258 passed, 3 skipped -- zero new contamination signature; (6) reran the predecessor's fresh phase-specific IV suite: 16 passed, unchanged. Diagnostic experimentation stopped at Stop Condition B (concrete technical blocker): the only remaining evidence-supported diagnostic avenue -- completing the execution-time trace to full coverage, or reproducing the failure with instrumentation attached via a full-suite pass -- requires ~140 minutes at the observed rate, which structurally exceeds this phase's 58-minute diagnostic ceiling even for a single pass (let alone the required fresh-process confirmatory repeat). This is a quantified, budget-driven infeasibility, not 'more candidates remain': the reload/sys.modules/monkeypatch-rebind mechanism class is now exhaustively closed both statically (whole-codebase) and dynamically (~14% of real execution, zero deviation).
